title: 第533章 百年沉眠上第532章 天道拷问
lines: 外界，战火纷飞，岁月如刀。
自云澈重伤垂死，被青帝三人带回“翠微天”
已匆匆十年。
这十年，对诸界战场而言，是血腥而残酷的十年。
吞噬族的攻势一浪高过一浪，其贪婪暴虐的本性在战争中展现得淋漓尽致。
它们不占据土地，不掠夺资源，只吞噬一切蕴含文明本源、生命精华、乃至世界规则的存在。
所过之处，星辰化为死寂的岩石，世界崩解为虚无的尘埃，只留下被“污秽”
浸染、难以修复的焦土。
联军方面，虽有来自诸天万界的强者源源不断支援，更有数位文明主君级别的老牌强者坐镇，但在吞噬族那同样不弱、甚至在某些方面更加诡异难缠的文明主君率领下，依旧节节败退，防线不断收缩。
十年间，已有超过十个大小不等的世界彻底沦陷，被吞噬一空，无数生灵惨遭灭绝。
战争的阴云，沉甸甸地压在每一个联军战士心头。
“翠微天”
这方小世界，因其位置隐秘，且有枯萎圣木残留的天然屏障，暂时未被战火波及，但也绝非绝对安全。
青帝、冥皇、羽曦三人，肩负着守护云澈的重任，却也无法完全置身事外。
熔山统领在得知云澈重伤未死但昏迷不醒后，虽感惋惜，却也理解，并未强求他们立即返回前线，但偶尔会有紧急求援或重要情报通过特殊渠道传来，需要他们出手或提供建议。
更多的时候，是联军中与云澈等人有过一面之缘、或钦佩其之前表现的战友，在轮换休整时，会悄悄送来一些疗伤圣药或打探消息，留下一声叹息后，又匆匆返回那血肉磨盘般的战场。
静室之内，灵池之中，云澈依旧静静地躺着。
他的外表，在青帝不惜代价的生命法则滋养和圣木残骸的温养下，似乎恢复了一些。
断裂的骨骼被重新接续，虽然布满细密的裂痕，但至少有了形状；破碎的脏腑被生命力模拟、填充，勉强维持着基本功能；皮肤上的裂痕也浅淡了许多。
然而，这一切都只是表象。
他体内，那天命法相依旧布满裂痕，黯淡无光，熔炉中的火星依旧微弱。
最根本的道伤，那源自文明主君、侵蚀了存在根基的“吞噬”
与“秩序”
碾压留下的创伤，并未有丝毫好转的迹象。
他就像一具被精美修复、却失去了灵魂的瓷器，徒有其形。
青帝、冥皇、羽曦三人轮流守候。
青帝主内，以生命法则和木族秘法，日夜不停地温养云澈的肉身与神魂，试图唤醒其生机；冥皇主外，以死亡法则布下隐匿与警戒结界，同时不断平衡云澈体内因长期沉寂而产生的“寂灭”
倾向；羽曦则凭借极速，负责外界联络、物资收集与警戒巡视。
十年如一日，他们从未放弃希望，但眉宇间的沉重与忧虑，却与日俱增。
云澈的气息，始终如同风中残烛，微弱得仿佛下一刻就会彻底熄灭。
文明主君造成的道伤，比他们想象的更加顽固，更加深邃。
而在云澈的意识深处，那一片被信仰微光守护的黑暗里，时间以另一种方式流淌。
这里没有日月轮转，没有四季更迭，只有无尽的沉寂与缓慢的、如同冰川移动般的思考。
自那日“天道拷问”
之后，云澈残存的意识，便不再沉沦于纯粹的虚无与痛苦。
他将所有残存的意念，所有还能调动的感知，全部投入到一个浩瀚而艰难的工程之中——理解“秩序”
最初，这思考是极其缓慢、极其模糊的。
他的意识如同破碎的琉璃，勉强粘合，念头生灭不定。
但他牢牢抓住了“秩序”
这个核心，如同抓住了一根救命稻草，在信仰微光的照耀下，开始艰难地回溯，回溯自己漫长生命中的点点滴滴。
他“看”
到了幼年在九域的懵懂，看到了宗门内的等级森严与资源分配，那是一种基于实力与资历的、简单而原始的“秩序”
content_en:
Outside, war is raging and time is like a knife.
Since Yun Che was seriously injured and dying, he was brought back to "Cuiweitian" by Qingdi and the others
Ten years have passed.
These ten years were bloody and cruel for the battlefields of all realms.
The Devouring Tribe's attacks were getting stronger and stronger, and their greedy and tyrannical nature was fully demonstrated in the war.
They do not occupy land or plunder resources. They only devour everything that contains the origin of civilization, the essence of life, and even the rules of the world.
Wherever it passes, the stars turn into dead rocks, and the world collapses into dust of nothingness, leaving only the "dirty"
Stained, scorched earth beyond repair.
As for the coalition forces, although there is a steady stream of support from strong men from all over the world, and there are also several veteran strong men at the level of civilized lords, they are still retreating steadily under the leadership of the Devouring Clan's civilized lord, who is also not weak, and even more weird and difficult in some aspects, and the defense line continues to shrink.
In the past ten years, more than ten worlds of various sizes have completely fallen and been swallowed up, and countless creatures have been exterminated.
The dark cloud of war weighs heavily on the hearts of every coalition soldier.
"Cui Wei Tian"
This small world, due to its hidden location and the natural barrier left by the withered sacred tree, has not been affected by the war for the time being, but it is by no means absolutely safe.
Qing Emperor, Ming Emperor, and Yu Xi shoulder the important task of protecting Yun Che, but they cannot completely stay out of it.
After learning that Yun Che was seriously injured but unconscious but unconscious, Commander Laoshan felt sorry but also understood. He did not force them to return to the front line immediately. However, occasionally there would be urgent requests for help or important information coming through special channels, requiring their intervention or advice.
More often than not, it was the comrades in the coalition who had met Yun Che and others, or who admired his previous performance, who would quietly send some healing holy medicine or inquire about information during the rotation, and after leaving a sigh, they hurriedly returned to the battlefield like a millstone of flesh and blood.
In the quiet room and in the spiritual pool, Yun Che was still lying quietly.
His appearance seemed to have recovered somewhat under the nourishment of the Qing Emperor's Law of Life at all costs and the warmth of the remains of the sacred tree.
The broken bones were reconnected, and although they were full of fine cracks, they at least had a shape; the broken organs were simulated and filled with life force, barely maintaining their basic functions; the cracks on the skin were also much lighter.
However, this is all just appearances.
In his body, the destiny law was still full of cracks and dim, and the sparks in the furnace were still weak.
The most fundamental Taoist injury is the "swallowing" that originates from the master of civilization and erodes the foundation of existence.
and "order"
The trauma left by the crush showed no signs of getting better.
He is like a piece of porcelain that has been beautifully restored but has lost its soul.
Qing Emperor, Ming Emperor, and Yu Xi took turns waiting.
Inside the Qing Emperor, he used the Law of Life and the secret method of the Wood Clan to warm up Yun Che's body and soul day and night, trying to awaken his vitality; outside the Lord Underworld, he used the Law of Death to set up a concealment and warning barrier, while constantly balancing the "death" in Yun Che's body caused by long-term silence.
Yu Xi relies on her extreme speed to be responsible for external communication, material collection and security patrols.
For ten years, they never gave up hope, but the heaviness and worry between their brows grew day by day.
Yun Che's breath was always like a candle in the wind, so weak that it seemed that it would be completely extinguished in the next moment.
The wounds caused by the Civilized Lord were more stubborn and deeper than they imagined.
And deep in Yun Che's consciousness, in the darkness guarded by the glimmer of faith, time flows in another way.
There is no rotation of the sun and the moon here, no change of seasons, just endless silence and slow thinking like the movement of a glacier.
Since that day, "Heavenly Torture"
After that, Yun Che's remaining consciousness no longer sank into pure nothingness and pain.
He devoted all his remaining thoughts and all the perceptions he could still mobilize into a vast and difficult project - understanding "order"
At first, this thinking was extremely slow and vague.
His consciousness was like broken glass, barely able to stick together, and his thoughts were uncertain.
But he firmly grasped "order"
This core is like grasping a life-saving straw. Under the glimmer of faith, it begins to look back with difficulty, looking back at every bit of its long life.
He "sees"
When I was young and ignorant in the Nine Domains, I saw the strict hierarchy and resource distribution within the sect. It was a simple and primitive "order" based on strength and seniority.
